description: Core 1.0 does not support chomping indicators `|-`/`|+` (Appendix A: not needed without `>`) — each is an ordinary unquoted string, and the following freetext line is not part of it. Non-strict: the inline value is kept, the freetext line is silently skipped. Mirrors the already-covered `>` case (core.block-scalar.folded-marker-unsupported.*).
